scope_description: Projects with at least 10 API tests and at least 1 identified application endpoint.

method.undefined_values: A project whose measure is undefined is omitted from that measure's correlation; project_count is the n for each measure.

header_check_rate.description: Share of API tests asserting on at least one response header.

body_verification_rate.description: Share of API tests asserting on the response body.

multi_request_rate.description: Share of API tests dispatching at least two HTTP request events.

error_status_assertion_rate.description: Share of API tests asserting at least one 4xx or 5xx status.

state_verification_rate.description: Share of API tests that write a resource through the API and then read the same resource back.

http_verb_repetition_rate.description: Share of consecutive HTTP test-sequence pairs (within a test) that repeat the same HTTP verb; undefined for projects without such pairs.

endpoint_coverage.description: Share of application endpoints covered by at least one test.

simple_1_way_optional_coverage.description: Mean simple 1-way optional-parameter coverage over covered endpoints; undefined for projects without a covered endpoint declaring an optional parameter.
